docs/ESP_CHARGES.md section 6 -- ESP under PCM is now LABELLED. The fitted density is solvent-polarized (the reaction field enters the Fock each SCF iteration) but the potential is the gas-phase form phi = nuc - el, excluding the reaction field's own sum_i q_i/|r - s_i|. Both quantities are legitimate -- the force-field (AMBER/RESP) convention wants exactly this one, since the MD solvent supplies the continuum -- and neither was identified before, so a user comparing against another code's in-solvent potential could not tell which they had. Sanity: PCM polarizes water further than gas phase, O -0.73608497 against -0.708804 unrestrained on the identical grid, the expected direction. The charges are pinned so that when item (b) adds the reaction field behind a keyword, this case shows the DEFAULT did not move -- which is the check that would catch the term being wired in unconditionally. Re-pinned 2026-11-07 for the SWIG cavity (docs/PCM_GEOMETRY.md step 1): 302 Lebedev points instead of 24 Fibonacci points, f(eps) = (eps-1)/eps, modified Bondi H. The converged ENERGY is pinned above to 1e-9 and is the correctness claim; the iteration count is a convergence-path detail that ULP-level changes in the integral engine can shift without moving the answer.
